name: Mito Mashiro
source:
She calls [url=/c1561]Yuuri[/url] her husband. Pretty obvious from her cute ears that she isn’t a human. She has considerable power even among the tayutama and hopes for the union of humans and tayutama. She doesn’t get the current technology so it’s pretty funny to see her fumble around with it. She has a pretty optimistic and cute personality. Florence student.

[From [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/03/29/%E3%82%BF%E3%83%A6%E3%82%BF%E3%83%9E-kiss-on-my-deity-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
